items.title: Tree down on Mountain Charlie
items.summary: Branches blocking one lane just past Summit Rd. The county has been called.

items.title: Injured deer at Summit and Morrell
items.summary: A deer with a hurt leg by the side of the road. Drive slowly.

items.title: Loose dog on Spanish Ranch
items.summary: A small brown and white dog, maybe a beagle, seen running toward the canyon.

items.title: Summit Rd one lane at a time
items.summary: Traffic control between Hwy 17 and Old Santa Cruz Hwy. About a 10 minute wait.
